text: Adorned with the Mandakini, the Saikata, and the Vedika, she, accompanied by artificial balls and dolls, repeatedly delighted in the midst of her companions, fully savoring the essence of childhood play. The swan garlands, like the Ganges in autumn; the great medicinal herbs, like the night; and the steady instruction, like the time for teaching—all these, as if born of a previous life, flowed into her.
